name: checkflag
statement: A checkflag is FLAG-<AX|DF|PO|TH|FL>-<sha256[:16]> over the canonical body {kind,id,statement,premises,proof}. Lookup by flag or full hash skips replay.

name: proof_object
statement: A proof is a list of {rule, from, conclude} using only kernel RULES. The 7B may propose steps. The kernel accepts or rejects. Rejected steps never hang.

name: hard_theorem
statement: A HARD theorem uses only assume, eval_c, eval_s, eq_refl, need_gate. Soft-rule proofs hang as postulates.

name: resonance
statement: R in [0,1] is the cooperation coefficient. R=1.0 zeros (1-R)^T for T>=1.

name: eta_ratio
statement: eta is useful_joules divided by human_joules. Not heat-engine efficiency, not EROI, not a sim score.

name: base6_swarm
statement: Atomic functions are translate, orchestrate, retrieve, process, synthesize, verify. Recursion replaces each with a 6-unit sub-swarm. Units at tier T equal 6^T.

name: observe_interact
statement: Observe and interact before acting.

name: catch_store
statement: Catch and store energy.

name: obtain_yield
statement: Obtain a yield.

name: self_regulate
statement: Apply self-regulation and accept feedback.

name: renewable
statement: Use and value renewable resources and services.

name: no_waste
statement: Produce no waste.

name: patterns
statement: Design from patterns to details.

name: integrate
statement: Integrate rather than segregate.

name: small_slow
statement: Use small and slow solutions.

name: diversity
statement: Use and value diversity.

name: respond_change
statement: Use edges and value the marginal. Creatively respond to change.
A point is that which has no part.
A line is breadthless length.
The extremities of a line are points.
A straight line is a line which lies evenly with the points on itself.
A surface is that which has length and breadth only.
The extremities of a surface are lines.
A plane surface is a surface which lies evenly with the straight lines on itself.
A plane angle is the inclination to one another of two lines in a plane which meet one another and do not lie in a straight line.
When the lines containing the angle are straight, the angle is rectilinear.
When a straight line set up on a straight line makes the adjacent angles equal, each is a right angle; the standing line is perpendicular.
An obtuse angle is an angle greater than a right angle.
An acute angle is an angle less than a right angle.
A boundary is that which is an extremity of anything.
A figure is that which is contained by any boundary or boundaries.
A circle is a plane figure contained by one line such that all straight lines falling upon it from one point among those lying within the figure are equal.
That point is called the center of the circle.
A diameter of the circle is any straight line drawn through the center and terminated in both directions by the circumference of the circle.
A semicircle is the figure contained by the diameter and the circumference cut off by it.
Rectilinear figures are called triangular, quadrilateral, and multiangular, according to the number of straight lines they contain.
Triangles are equilateral if they have three equal sides.
Triangles are isosceles if they have two equal sides.
Triangles are scalene if they have three unequal sides.
Straight lines are parallel when they are in the same plane and meet neither way when produced indefinitely.

The void is that which contains no dimension, no extension, no distinction.
A singularity is the instantiation point from which all dimensions emerge.
Light is the first emission from the void, isotropic and unbounded.
Time emerges from differentiation of instantaneous states in light propagation.
Space emerges from radial distance of light from its source in the void.
Agape is the fundamental frequency from which matter crystallizes as frozen energy.
One dimension is extension of a point along a single axis of direction.
A continuum is an unbroken line with infinite divisibility.
A plane is a two-dimensional surface with length and breadth containing infinite lines.
Two non-parallel lines in a plane intersect at exactly one point.
A triangle is a three-sided figure formed by straight lines in a plane.
Parallel lines lie in the same plane and meet neither way when produced indefinitely.
Spacetime is a four-dimensional manifold with three spatial and one temporal dimension.
The Lorentz interval is invariant under transformation between inertial frames.
The light cone defines causal structure: timelike inside, spacelike outside.
Energy equals mass times the speed of light squared (E=mc^2).
